I'll select direction 2 to practice interpreting 回收利用 in context.

<tool_call>
<function=build_question_answers><parameter=stem>What does the phrase 回收利用 tell you about the paper in this instruction?</parameter><parameter=passage>纸张可以回收利用，所以请放进回收箱。</parameter><parameter=answerA>The paper is too dirty to be used again, so it must be thrown away.</parameter><parameter=answerB>The paper can be processed and used again, which is why it belongs in the recycling bin.</parameter><parameter=answerC>The paper is a special material that must be kept separate from all other waste.</parameter><parameter=answerD>The paper is valuable and should be sold to a collector.</parameter><parameter=correct>B</parameter><parameter=feedback>The phrase 回收利用 means to recycle and reuse, so it explains that the paper can be processed and used again. That is the reason (所以) it goes in the recycling bin. The other options invent reasons not stated: throwing it away, keeping it separate for a special reason, or selling it, none of which match the idea of recycling and reusing.</parameter><parameter=waypointIds>["w2"]</parameter><parameter=cardId>card-fe6c12ce-0401-4be7-98d1-ee84fd937bcb</parameter><parameter=intent>Interpret the meaning of 回收利用 in the context of the statement 纸张可以回收利用.</parameter><parameter=whyMissing>No current practice question yet tests whether the learner understands that 回收利用 means the paper can be recycled and reused, which is the stated reason it goes in the recycling bin.</parameter></function></tool_call>

I'll select direction 1 to practice interpreting 分类投放 in the instruction context.

<tool_call>
<function=build_question_answers><parameter=stem>What does the instruction ask visitors to do with their waste after the exhibition?</parameter><parameter=passage>请分类投放垃圾。</parameter><parameter=answerA>Separate the waste by type and place each kind into its correct bin.</parameter><parameter=answerB>Throw all the waste into one single bin without sorting it.</parameter><parameter=answerC>Recycle the waste and reuse it for new products.</parameter><parameter=answerD>Keep the waste and take it home instead of discarding it.</parameter><parameter=correct>A</parameter><parameter=feedback>The phrase 分类投放 means to sort and put into the appropriate bins, so the instruction asks visitors to separate waste by type and place each kind in its correct bin.
